topic.angle: The five weighted factors of a FICO Score

body.claim: A FICO Score is built from five weighted categories, and payment history counts the most.
body.why: Payment history makes up 35%, amounts owed 30%, length of credit history 15%, new credit 10% and credit mix 10%. It is built mainly from your credit report, so personal details like income and age are not part of it.

probes.question: Which category carries the most weight in a FICO Score?
True or false: your salary is one of the factors in your FICO Score.
